mission: Construct an exact universal polynomial-time SAT/CSP algorithm if one exists, by composing all source-backed tractable mechanisms without exponential hidden state or semantic oracles.

imported_module.name: RESIDUALLY_SMALL_CUBE_EFFECTIVE_PP_NORMALIZATION

unconditional_barrier.name: NO_SINGLE_FIXED_EDGE_TERM_PP_CARRIER_FOR_ARBITRARY_3SAT
reason: Boolean 3SAT language has only projection polymorphisms.
pp-definability preserves polymorphisms: if R is pp-definable from Gamma then Pol(Gamma) is contained in Pol(R).
A few-subpowers language has a nontrivial edge polymorphism.
Therefore arbitrary 3SAT cannot be pp-defined from one fixed edge-term/few-subpowers language while retaining that edge polymorphism.
unconditional_barrier.consequence: The universal route must be instance-specific, heterogeneous, dynamic, or use a non-pp transformation; merely enlarging the fixed cube-term carrier cannot cover arbitrary signed 3SAT.
